sentences.text: [slightly surprised] Why is there a little green man running on every exit sign?
You see, in nineteen seventy-two, an Osaka department store filled with smoke, and a hundred and eighteen people never found the way out.
So Japan held a contest, and thousands of drawings were tested in rooms full of smoke.
So why does he look like he's barely jogging?
[matter-of-fact] The designer drew him sprinting, and the judges made him slow down so you wouldn't panic.
Now almost the whole world uses him, except America, which still writes EXIT in red, the color for stop.
The newest building code finally lets America switch, and I think it should.
